executive_summary.value: Oleum Joint Venture is a Tijuana-based S. de R.L. de C.V. founded in 2014 by Luis Francisco Serrano Lluch and Isidro Anguiano Campos. Serrano Lluch is the founder, legal rep, and almost certainly the sole decision-maker — Anguiano Campos is a corporate lawyer at 'lluch y asociados' (the family firm) and plays an administrative/legal role, not hospitality strategy. Oleum owns 70.57 hectares on Punta Venado (purchased for $19.4M in 2017, title liberated 2025). The 572-key ecotourism complex was authorized in April 2026 (5.5-year construction window). Crucially, Oleum also holds the Ritz-Carlton license (RMLA) for The Ritz-Carlton Residences, Riviera Maya (127 residences + 300-room hotel) developed by Desarrolladora Arca (Gregorio Galicot, President). This Ritz-Carlton connection is THE introduction path: approach Desarrolladora Arca or the Ritz-Carlton Residences sales team as a bridge to Serrano Lluch. The architecture firm Sordo Madaleno and sales broker IMI Worldwide Properties (Mike Collins) also connect to the Ritz-Carlton project. For the ecotourism complex specifically, Serrano Lluch is the only decision-maker — but he has no LinkedIn, no corporate website, and no publicly available contact. The Ritz-Carlton Residences sales team at +1(800)939-0024 or sales@RCRrivieramaya.com is the most reliable initial contact route.

Additionally, Serrano Lluch's broader business interests (Fimubac SOFOM, Baja Cacho) suggest a diversified investor who may pursue additional hospitality projects. However, Oleum is not an institutional platform — it's a private investment vehicle controlled by one principal. Relationship value is 'several' — limited to known 2 projects, not portfolio-scale.
dealality_relationship_value.method: assess scope: 2 documented hospitality projects, single principal
dealality_relationship_value.evidence: Ecotourism complex confirmed. Ritz-Carlton RMLA connection confirmed. No evidence of additional hospitality pipeline.

decision_maker_1_why_matters.value: Founder who controls Oleum Joint Venture — the entity that owns the land (folio real 156020), filed the MIA, and is the developer for the 572-key ecotourism complex. Also the entity that holds the Ritz-Carlton RMLA license. All material decisions for the ecotourism complex (brand, operator, capital, development partners) flow through Serrano Lluch. He is the sole identified strategic decision-maker for Oleum — Anguiano Campos is legal/administrative, not hospitality strategy.
decision_maker_1_why_matters.method: analyze decision-maker role vs. other founders
decision_maker_1_why_matters.evidence: Serrano Lluch is legal rep + founder; Anguiano Campos is a corporate lawyer with no hospitality background. The naming of 'lluch y asociados' (the law firm) suggests Serrano Lluch's family controls the professional services infrastructure.

decision_maker_2_why_matters.value: Co-founder of Oleum Joint Venture — likely has administrative and legal decision authority. However, his background is purely legal (25+ yrs as corporate lawyer at 'lluch y asociados') and he has no visible hospitality operations or strategy experience. He is likely the administrative/legal gatekeeper who handles contracts and compliance but defers to Serrano Lluch on strategic decisions like brand/operator selection. As a co-founder, he could be an alternative contact if Serrano Lluch is unreachable, but he is not the hospitality decision-maker.
decision_maker_2_why_matters.method: analyze LinkedIn profile for role significance
decision_maker_2_why_matters.evidence: LinkedIn: 25+ yrs as corporate lawyer. Skills: contract drafting, corporate incorporation, anti-money-laundering. No hospitality experience. Only 80 LinkedIn connections.

recommended_dealality_strategy.value: 1) First contact: IMI Worldwide Properties (Mike Collins) or the Ritz-Carlton Residences sales team at +1(800)939-0024. Reference the Ritz-Carlton project and request a conversation about hospitality advisory — this is the only warm entry point. 2) Once connected with Desarrolladora Arca (Gregorio Galicot) or IMI, pivot to inquire about Oleum Joint Venture and the principals behind the RMLA license. 3) Frame Dealality's value proposition around the 572-key ecotourism complex — where no brand/operator is announced and Oleum has no hotel operating track record. 4) Emphasize that the Ritz-Carlton relationship demonstrates Oleum's familiarity with luxury brand partnerships, and that Dealality can help replicate this model for the ecotourism complex. 5) If direct routes fail, search for Serrano Lluch through Mexican corporate registry databases (Dateas, Buró de Crédito) for alternate corporate contact information. 6) Monitor SEMARNAT for ecotourism complex construction start — once construction begins, the urgency for brand/operator selection increases. This is the second-strongest package after Tortuga but outreach is significantly harder.
recommended_dealality_strategy.method: synthesize strategy from all available intelligence
recommended_dealality_strategy.evidence: Strategy built around Ritz-Carlton bridge + ecotourism complex opportunity
